name: ahde
description: Agent Harness Development Environment — build, run, trace, eval, improve project-specific agents

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cli.js', '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' + require('fs').readFileSync('dist/cli.js'))" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.vendor:build: cd vendor/pi-mono && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run hydrate:model-data && npm run build:offline
scripts.vendor:pack: cd vendor/pi-mono/packages/telemetry && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../ai && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../agent && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../protocol && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../client && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../tui && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs && cd ../coding-agent && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../tarballs
